title: platform-validation-evidence-plan/1
description: The evidence the platform validation summary (generator 22, --platform-evidence) admits, per system of the platform inventory (TA3 plan VAL-1, spec P20 3.3 and 3.7). Producer: the operator (the validation lead, VAL-1/validation-run step 3); owner and consumer: accuratrail-validation-framework (runners/platform-evidence-plan.ts parses it strictly; runners/evidence-package.ts checks every entry against the bytes it names; a retained package copies it to inputs/platform-evidence-plan.json). Evidence is admitted only by hash: a validation-evidence-package/1 by the SHA-256 of its package-manifest.json, verified with verifyPackage, any other kind by the file's own SHA-256 alone. A system the inventory lacks, an entry kind the inventory does not admit for the system, a synthetic declaration that differs from the cited package manifest, or a package without the evidence category its system needs (the Intelligence Layer: p13; the Command Center: benchmark) refuses the plan. Any synthetic entry makes the documents package synthetic.

preparedBy.description: Who prepared the plan (a person or a role), as printable text.

systems.description: At least one system, keyed by its id in config/platform-inventory.ts.

kind.description: validation-evidence-package/1 for a sealed package of this framework; any other kind label is admitted by hash only.

path.description: Absolute path: a package directory or its package-manifest.json, or the file admitted by hash.

sha256.description: For a package, the SHA-256 of its package-manifest.json (npm run verify:package prints it); otherwise the SHA-256 of the file's bytes.

synthetic.description: For a package, it must equal the manifest's synthetic; otherwise the preparer's declaration, printed as declared.
